Sales Representative

Pure Moving

Países permitidosLATAM, México
Modalidad100% Remote (Home Office)

Descripción del puesto

Remote sales role working exclusively with warm inbound leads (no cold calling), offering $1,500 USD base salary plus bonuses up to $3,000 USD/month.

Funciones principales

  • Work exclusively with inbound leads — no cold calling.
  • Consult with clients to find the best moving solution.
  • Negotiate and close deals while maintaining accurate CRM records.

Requisitos

  • At least 1 year of proven sales experience.
  • Fluent English (required).
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and inbound lead conversion skills.

Beneficios

  • Base salary of $1,500 USD/month + bonuses (earnings up to $3,000 USD).
  • Fully remote position with official contract-based employment.
  • Comprehensive training and team support.
